text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Tuning year, 100 of the gate's transfers of 25% or 40% of the receiving load (recall; the registered dot reads all 200 such transfers) and the two placebo pairs with no interconnection (flow). Dashed lines: the gate's thresholds, recall 0.77 and flow 0.05 MW-days. Variants were chosen after the registered gate failed and cannot change the verdict.'
text.tspan: Tuning year, 100 of the gate's transfers of 25% or 40% of the receiving load (recall; the
registered dot reads all 200 such transfers) and the two placebo pairs with no interconnection
(flow). Dashed lines: the gate's thresholds, recall 0.77 and flow 0.05 MW-days. Variants were
chosen after the registered gate failed and cannot change the verdict.
